item.tib: byams ma sngags lugs kyi zin ris nor bu'i 'phreng ba
item.coloph: de ltar byams ma sngags sgrub kyi zin ris nor bu'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang 'dra'i blo rmongs lung rig nor gyi dben pa rnams kyi don du 'dzam gling bla ma mkhan chen rin po che nyi ma bstan 'dzin dbang gi rgyal po'i dngos slob drang srong bsam gtan nyi ma'i zhal rgyun 'khrul med 'di ni/ rnam 'od ming gis bris pa gshen bstan dar rgyas kyi rgyur gyur cig/
